sentence: This project studies whether blocking a receptor and podoplanin can stop platelets from helping pancreatic cancer grow and spread.
This project tries to find out how loss of progranulin lowers a fat found in lysosomes and whether raising it eases neurodegeneration.
This project studies how removing histone methyl marks with CRISPR works with DNA repair to shorten expanded GAA repeats in Friedreich's ataxia.
This project studies how a mitochondrial factor helps the heart remove and replace mitochondria when its metabolism changes in heart disease.
This project tests a live-attenuated vaccine against respiratory syncytial virus, meant for children, by changing interferon levels.
This project builds peptide nanostructures that make stem cell-derived heart cells respond to light so the cells mature better.
This project develops two methods that directly change microbial metabolites in place, to study how microbes and their host affect each other.
This project studies how inherited variation puts pressure on blood cells and makes blood cancers more likely to arise.
This project develops panels of biomarkers from blood, urine and biopsy tissue to tell low-risk prostate cancer from aggressive disease during active surveillance.
This project studies how a small group of progenitor cells become sensory neurons and hair cells in the inner ear.
This project looks for chemical probes that target Hectd3, a ligase that affects how severe multiple sclerosis is in a mouse model.
This project builds prediction models with machine learning to find people with obstructive sleep apnea who are at risk of cardiovascular disease.
This project tries to find out which cellular mechanisms control pain from the brain as acute pain turns into chronic pain.
This project studies how arsenic biotransformation disrupts gene regulation and blood cell development in blood stem cells.
This project measures how vocal fatigue builds up and recovers, using voice recordings made in the lab and in daily life.
This project studies the molecular links between inflamed fat around the heart and atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery.
This project studies how macrophages raise the risk of HIV in women who have bacterial vaginosis, using machine learning.
This project develops pulse sequences, reconstruction methods and analysis software for hyperpolarized MRI data that show metabolism.
This project studies genes that do not code for proteins to see how they change muscle in healthy people and in muscular dystrophy.
This project uses imaging and inherited DNA biomarkers to find which rectal cancer patients will respond best to different radiation treatments.
